{{Top|leg}}
'''Induction chips''' were a form of identification used by the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. They were issued to new recruits and draftees, and were required to allow onward transit to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] training facilities. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] agents infiltrating [[Training Camp IMIIF-138]] on [[Sirpar/Legends|Sirpar]] were supplied with induction chips acquired from draftees from [[Andooweel/Legends|Andooweel]] who had defected to the Alliance.<ref name="Army Now!">{{JournalCite|2|You're in the Army Now!|reprint=1}}</ref>
